rationale: Motor vehicle collision resulting in totaled vehicle and injury to the policyholder; clearly within auto insurance scope.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15 am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle with crush damage to the trunk and back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Third-party insurance information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
